subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Ler e compreender, com certa autonomia, textos em versos, explorando rimas, sons e jogos de palavras, imagens poéticas (sentidos figurados) e recursos visuais e sonoros.

components.description_pt: Identificar recursos sonoros como aliteração e rima em história, poema ou música
components.description_en: Identify sound devices such as alliteration and rhyme in a story, poem, or song
components.cc_component_description: Identify sound devices such as alliteration and rhyme in a story, poem, or song

components.description_pt: Interpretar significados figurados e imagética poética em textos em verso
components.description_en: Interpret figurative meanings and poetic imagery in verse texts
components.cc_component_description: Interpret figurative language, including simile, metaphor, and personification, in context

components.description_pt: Reconhecer recursos visuais e sonoros usados para criar sentido em poemas
components.description_en: Recognize visual and sound devices used to create meaning in poems
components.cc_component_description: Identify sound devices such as alliteration and rhyme in a story, poem, or song

cc_matches.description: Describe how words and phrases (e.g., regular beats, alliteration, rhymes, repeated lines) supply rhythm and meaning in a story, poem, or song.
Demonstrate understanding of figurative language, word relationships, and nuances in word meanings.
